code: the working tree of wf9/robustness at each run: the flags as in 'candidates', the periods as in cases.<id>.periods; the committed code is the K3d / ship state
decision: ship = K3d (the only candidate that passed the 10 Hz gate and improved the target); provisional_per_axis stays off

not_run.K4b: 10 Hz tilt runs equal K4c's but for the two stamp gaps of doubleT_obstacle; K4c already worse at roll_3 and pitch_3

K3d.periods: median of the last 9 stamp intervals (committed code)

ship.periods: median of the last 9 stamp intervals (committed code)
